title: Ollie: why the leg does not track
subtitle: Give a Paw × Bionic Pets
intro: Ollie's prosthetic leg does not move with him. It does not point where we want it to, it crosses over, and it drags on the floor. Below is the socket he wore, followed by the changes we are considering.
